current.text: He is expected to start at shooting guard for Detroit.
Even as a starter, he may be a half starter who plays only about 24 to 25 minutes.
He is only worth drafting in 20-team leagues. An ADP around 239 is right, and the Yahoo and ESPN ranks are too high.
He is a streaming option for threes, not a draft target.
Detroit plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest risks are expected.
Detroit is projected to win 50 to 51 games and finish third or fourth in the East.

durable.text: He is an elite three-point shooter.
His usage is low and he adds little besides threes.
His defense and passing have improved a lot.
He gets to the free throw line rarely, so his FT% barely moves a team's ratio.
